description: This file defines a class 'UploadContractDocumentTransformer' that implements data transformation for contract document uploads within a Symfony-based form. It provides methods to transform and reverse-transform document data, converting files into Document objects.

classes.name: UploadContractDocumentTransformer
classes.description: Implements data transformation logic specifically for uploading contract documents, converting raw file data into Document objects.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Returns null; typically used to transform Document objects into a format suitable for form display or storage.

methods.name: reverseTransform
methods.description: Converts an array of uploaded files into Document objects if they are not already instances of Document.
